other_failure_modes.name: Feature mismatch in fallback logic
other_failure_modes.description: In the fallback modelling path, the test DataFrame is repeatedly overwritten inside a loop that applies categorical frequency encoding. This causes all but the very last encoded column to be missing from the test set, which would lead to a feature mismatch crash during prediction.

summary: The solution implements strong feature engineering and handles complex JSON fields effectively. However, it suffers from critical data leakage by fitting unsupervised text extraction models (TF-IDF and SVD) on the concatenated train and test datasets. Additionally, it ignores the temporal nature of movie releases by using random K-Fold splits, and contains a severe bug in its fallback modelling logic that would cause a crash if CatBoost is unavailable.
